# Obsidian Vault

> A published Obsidian vault: 71 markdown notes. Every page is plain HTML; pages cross-link, so start anywhere and follow links.

## Machine-readable

- [Index (HTML, followable links)](https://unixuserdev.github.io/vault-index.html)
- [Full index (JSON, with note bodies)](https://unixuserdev.github.io/static/contentIndex.json)
- [Light index (JSON, no bodies)](https://unixuserdev.github.io/static/contentIndex.light.json)
- [Index (plain text)](https://unixuserdev.github.io/vault-index.txt)
- Per-note JSON: `https://unixuserdev.github.io/static/notes/<slug>.json` (use this when the full index truncates)
- Raw markdown source (`text/plain`): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UnixUserDev/UnixUserDev.github.io/gh-pages/vault/<path>.md
